Donald Trump lied to America. Costs are skyrocketing under his leadership. 

On top of a War in Iran and other failed policies skyrocketing costs he also slashed clean energy programs that could lower costs and create jobs. 

Donald Trump is failing America.

Here is to beauty, despite all the calamity. Here is to moments that stir the soul and awaken our shared humanity.

Here is to wonder. Here is to surprise. Here is to the small miracles that reopen our eyes.

Here is to laughter that lightens heavy days, To awe and connection in unexpected ways.

And here is to all the things, simple, sacred, and true That remind, us despite the challenges, life is a gift and we are lucky to live it through.

Video

Trump once warned that a President with “no ability to negotiate” would stumble into war with Iran. 

Now his reckless war is driving up gas prices and costing American families more at the pump and the grocery store.

I will keep fighting to stop this war and hold the administration accountable. 

op: @therecount

Video

Because of Trump’s war in Iran, fuel prices are skyrocketing, and American small businesses like these shrimpers are getting hammered at the fuel pump. 

We need leadership that doesn't drag us into endless conflicts making it impossible for working people to provide for their families, we need to redeem the dream for all Americans. 

op: @thewokeginger

Most Americans agree the Supreme Court should not have the weakest ethics laws in the country.

Most Americans – Republican and Democrat – don’t think justices should be able to hold onto their seats forever.

He said he would get us out of wars, he got us in one. He promised to lower prices, now they are skyrocketing.

While he's focused on a ballroom, Americans are paying the price for his war.

I just returned from Birmingham, Alabama - sacred ground where Americans were beaten, jailed, terrorized, and even killed for the simple but powerful right to vote.

Too many people want us to believe voter suppression is history. It is not.

Across our nation, we are watching new barriers rise, new tactics emerge, and old fears dressed up in modern language. The targets may change, the methods may evolve, but the purpose is painfully familiar: to silence voices and diminish power.

A great teacher does more than teach lessons.
They build confidence.
They awaken curiosity.
They help children believe they matter and that their dreams matter too.

Long after students forget the homework or the test, they remember the teacher who saw them, encouraged them, challenged them, and loved them enough to help them grow.

We must stand up  in Congress, in the courts, and at the ballot box. Our democracy demands nothing less.

I'm just back from Birmingham, Alabama where people paid for the right to vote with sweat, blood, and even their lives.

A dark moment in our nation’s history is repeating. But we must remember that we are not powerless.

We must stand up and continue to fight to ensure our voices are heard, just like the generations who came before us.
